representative_summary: Use libsodium-wrappers (not tweetnacl) for sealed-box despite +400KB bundle, because TweetNaCl doesn't ship sealed_box natively

payload.rationale: libsodium-wrappers is the only mainstream JS lib that exposes crypto_box_seal/seal_open natively; tweetnacl requires a custom impl which is exactly the kind of subtle crypto code we shouldn't write
